name: WeBox
purpose: Workplace meal delivery — individual Box Meals for lunch and dinner, delivered to your office

time_sensitive.note: Orders cannot be placed or modified after cutoff. Check cutoff before proceeding.

ordering_flow: 3. Select delivery date from the top navigation bar
4. Select meal period: Lunch or Dinner
5. Browse menu — filter by dietary preference if needed
6. Click dish to add to cart
8. Confirm delivery address and submit order
known_friction: Site is JavaScript-heavy — wait 3 seconds after page load before interacting
Menu is only visible after login
Delivery date must be selected before menu loads
Auto-orders exist — check if a meal is already ordered before placing a new one

useful_features.favorites: Heart icon on any dish saves it. Access via My Favorites in sidebar.
useful_features.auto_order: Weekly schedule can be set under profile menu — check before manual ordering to avoid duplicates
useful_features.guest_order: Click Guest Order in sidebar to order for a visitor or client
useful_features.order_cutoff_check: Always verify cutoff time before starting — visible in top navigation bar

today_menu.note: Today's menu is scraped daily and stored separately.

agent_instructions: Before placing any order on WeBox: (1) Check today_menu.url for today's available dishes, prices and dietary tags. (2) Verify the current time against time_sensitive cutoffs — abort if past cutoff. (3) Follow ordering_flow step by step. (4) Do not browse the menu page to explore — use today_menu data to plan the full order first, then execute directly.
